title: 过故人庄
author: 孟浩然
intro: An old friend kills a chicken and invites the poet to his farm. They drink, talk about crops, and before leaving the poet promises to come back for the chrysanthemums in autumn — a perfect day in the countryside.
analysis: 这首诗写诗人到老朋友的农家做客。开头很朴素：朋友准备了鸡和黄米饭，邀请我到他家。“鸡黍”是农家最好的饭菜，写出朋友的热情。三、四句写村庄的风景：绿树把村子围起来，青山在城外斜斜地伸向远方，近处是绿，远处是青，像一幅画。五、六句写吃饭的情景：打开窗户对着打谷场和菜园，端着酒杯聊庄稼的事——不谈官场，不谈名利，只说桑和麻长得怎么样，非常轻松自在。最后两句是告别时的约定：等到重阳节，我还要来这里赏菊花。不说“今天很开心”，只说“还要再来”，快乐和友情都在这句话里。全诗语言平淡自然，是田园诗的代表作。
analysisEn: An old friend has prepared chicken and millet — the best a farm household can offer — and invited the poet over. The second couplet paints the village: green trees close in around it, and blue hills slant away beyond the town wall; near and far, it looks like a landscape painting. Then the visit itself: they open the window onto the threshing ground and the vegetable garden, raise their cups and chat about mulberry and hemp — that is, about crops. No talk of careers, office or fame, only the easy concerns of farm life. The last couplet is the promise made at the gate: “When the Double Ninth comes, I’ll be back for the chrysanthemums.” The poet never says he had a wonderful time; wanting to come again says it for him. The language is plain and calm, and the poem is one of the best-known examples of Tang “pastoral poetry” — poems about the peace of country life.
background: Meng Haoran (689–740) lived most of his life as a recluse near Xiangyang in Hubei and never held office. He was a close friend of Wang Wei, and the two are seen as the leading Tang poets of landscape and country life.
pronunciation: 还来 huán（回来，不读 hái）；重阳 chóng；场圃 chǎng pǔ。青山郭外斜：斜 统编教材注 xié；为押韵旧读 xiá，网站按 xié。
version: 采用通行教材版本。末句“还来就菊花”，有的版本作“还来醉菊花”或“还来对菊花”，网站按教材作“就”。

lines.lit: My old friend prepared chicken and millet,
lines.en: My old friend got chicken and millet ready
and asked me to his farm.

lines.lit: Green trees close round the village edge;
lines.en: Green trees gather round the village;

lines.lit: blue hills slant beyond the outer wall.
lines.en: blue hills slope off beyond the town wall.

lines.lit: Opening the window, we face threshing floor and garden;
lines.en: We open the window on yard and garden,

lines.lit: holding wine, we talk of mulberry and hemp.
lines.en: cups in hand, we talk about the crops.

lines.lit: Wait until the Double Ninth day —
lines.en: When the Double Ninth comes round,

lines.lit: I will come back to be near the chrysanthemums.
lines.en: I’ll come back for the chrysanthemums.

words.note: 古义，现代汉语说“拜访”；“过”今天多指经过。
古义；今天“故人”多指去世的人，要小心。
古义；今天“具”多指工具，如“餐具”。

words.en: chicken and millet — a hearty farm meal

words.note: 古代内城叫城，外城叫郭；今天作姓氏常见。
古义；今天多用于店名、书房名。

words.en: to hold a cup of wine

words.note: 古义作动词；现代汉语“话家常”还保留这个用法。

words.en: mulberry and hemp — farm work, crops
words.note: 桑叶养蚕，麻织布，代指农事。

words.en: Double Ninth Festival (9th day of 9th lunar month)
words.note: 今天仍过重阳节，有登高、赏菊的习俗，现在也是敬老节。
古义读 huán；今天“还”多读 hái。
古义；现代汉语“就近”“迁就”。

imagery.name: 菊
imagery.zh: 重阳节赏菊是习俗，菊花也代表田园生活的闲适和高洁。
imagery.en: Admiring chrysanthemums is a Double Ninth custom; the flower also stands for the calm, pure life of the countryside.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 端着酒杯聊农事，酒在这里是朋友间轻松、亲切的交流。
imagery.en: Cups in hand while chatting about crops — here wine means easy, warm friendship.

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 城外的青山斜斜伸向远方，给村庄画出一道美丽的背景。
imagery.en: Blue hills slanting away beyond the wall make a peaceful backdrop for the village.
